title: Hospital Playlist
hook: How does Hospital Playlist end? The five friends pair off, Jeong-won's year abroad, Jun-wan and Ik-sun reunite, and the last jam session, explained.

sections.heading: Ik-jun and Song-hwa finally say it out loud
sections.body: The Season 2 finale lands the relationship the show teased the longest. Chae Song-hwa and Lee Ik-jun officially confirm they are dating, with Song-hwa even acknowledging it to the rest of the friend group during one of their gatherings. The other doctors barely believe it because the pair were always this comfortable together, and the recap notes that nothing about their dynamic really changed, they simply added the label. The two are shown flirting, teasing, and openly affectionate across the episode, including a relaxed karaoke scene, resolving the will-they-wont-they at the heart of the season.

sections.heading: Jeong-won and Gyeo-ul, love across an ocean
sections.body: Ahn Jeong-won announces he is leaving to the United States for a year to study small-bowel transplantation, news that initially worries his friends until he reveals he will not be going alone. Jang Gyeo-ul is going with him. She has grown certain of her feelings, openly tells him she loves him, and wants to introduce him to her mother, the once-guarded resident now fully committed. Their arc, which spent two seasons inching forward, ends with the two settled enough as a couple to plan a year abroad side by side rather than apart.

sections.heading: Jun-wan, Ik-sun, and Seok-hyeong's quiet wins
sections.body: Kim Jun-wan and Lee Ik-sun, the couple the season kept at a painful distance, finally close the gap. Jun-wan reaches her and the two reunite with a long-awaited embrace, the finale framing them with renewed hope. Yang Seok-hyeong and Min-ha get their moment too, sharing a passionate kiss after Min-ha tells him she has waited a long time for him. Around them the supporting threads resolve warmly, including good news for Jae-hak with a new baby and his wife's encouraging chemotherapy results, the show stacking gentle happy endings rather than big dramatic turns.

sections.heading: The band, and a sky full of friends
sections.body: True to a series built on music and friendship, the five doctors gather for one last band jam session, as wholesome as every rehearsal that came before. The finale deliberately avoids high-stakes melodrama, choosing instead to reward the audience with closure for each character and couple. Hospital Playlist ends on its core thesis, that ordinary kindness, steady work, and the company of old friends are themselves the happy ending, the medical drama trading cliffhangers for a sense of lives quietly continuing well beyond the final episode.

final_image: The five friends stand together outside the hospital looking up at the sky, a calm group shot that serves as the show's closing image of contentment.

lingering_questions.q: Do Ik-jun and Song-hwa end up together in Hospital Playlist?
lingering_questions.a: Yes. The Season 2 finale has them confirm they are dating, with Song-hwa even telling the friend group. They are shown openly affectionate, resolving the show's longest-running romantic thread on a happy note.

lingering_questions.q: Do Jun-wan and Ik-sun get back together?
lingering_questions.a: Yes. After being kept apart for much of the season, Jun-wan reaches Ik-sun and the two reunite with an emotional embrace, with the finale clearly signaling hope for the couple going forward.
